name: Memories of East Coast
source:
Memories of East Coast takes you, as the character Sam, on a journey through memory, nostalgia, and guilt. As he revisits a place he hasn’t been to in fifteen years, an unexpected specter from his past emerges, forcing him to face those ghosts once again in new ways.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607430/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《Memories of East Coast》中，你将扮演山姆，踏上一段穿行于记忆、怀旧与愧疚之间的旅程。重返十五年未曾到访的地方时，一道意想不到的往昔幽影浮现，迫使他以新的方式，再次面对那些挥之不去的过去。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607430/]Steam[/url]]
